title: AIP v3.0 Message Envelope
description:
Base envelope shared by every AIP v3.0 message.  All message-specific schemas must reference ($ref) this envelope and add their own required/payload fields.

Legacy clients (AIP/1.x, 2.x) are accepted at the ingress boundary and automatically upgraded to v3 by galaxy_gateway/protocol/compat.py before reaching any handler.

version.description: Protocol version.  Must be '3.0' or higher (e.g. '3.1').  Legacy clients that omit this field or send '1.x'/'2.x' are auto-converted by the compat layer.

type.description: Canonical AIP v3 message type string (see MessageType enum in aip_v3.py).

device_id.description: Unique identifier of the originating device.

message_id.description: Unique message identifier (UUID v4).  Auto-generated when absent.

correlation_id.description: Links a response message back to its request message_id.

timestamp.description: Message creation time.  Accepted as ISO-8601 string or Unix-millisecond integer.

task_id.description: Optional task identifier used to correlate task lifecycle messages.

task_status.description: Current status of the associated task.

commands.description: Ordered list of Command objects to execute.

results.description: Execution results corresponding to previously received commands.

error.description: Human-readable error description (used in ERROR messages).

trace_id.description: Distributed tracing identifier (UUID).  Auto-injected by compat layer when absent.

route_mode.description: Routing hint.  Auto-injected by compat layer when absent.
